notes: Machine-readable license/dependency inventory for Numeris (spec §5.1). Every component shipped in a Numeris build is listed here with its license. All third-party entries are permissively licensed (MIT, Apache-2.0, or MIT OR Apache-2.0); no copyleft dependency exists in the build graph. Human-readable attribution: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. License texts: LICENSES/.

components.name: numeris-core
components.usage: Numeris-owned component. DataFrame, RFC 4180 CSV reader, descriptive statistics, statistical distributions (Normal/t/F/chi-square CDFs and quantiles), and the error model. Independent in-repo implementation; contains no third-party statistical or numerical code.

components.name: numeris-stats
components.usage: Numeris-owned component. OLS (QR), WLS, 2SLS/IV, robust/cluster/HAC covariance, panel fixed-effects (within) and between estimators, DID, logit, probit, Poisson (IRLS), diagnostics, and the golden/NIST StRD validation suite. Independent in-repo implementation; contains no third-party statistical or numerical code.

components.name: numeris-command
components.usage: Numeris-owned component. Command DSL: lexer, parser, AST, validation and execution, canonical command rendering for GUI-command equivalence.

components.name: numeris-project
components.usage: Numeris-owned component. .numeris project directory format, research registry, environment manifest, replay/reproducibility engine.

components.name: serde
components.usage: Serialization framework for the canonical object model, command ASTs and .numeris project files. One of only two third-party dependencies of the engine crates.

components.name: serde_json
components.usage: JSON reading/writing for project files, result objects and JSON import/export. One of only two third-party dependencies of the engine crates.

components.name: tauri
components.usage: Desktop shell (windows, menus, IPC, packaging, updater integration) for apps/desktop/src-tauri.

components.name: tauri-build
components.usage: Build-time helper generating the Tauri context and capability plumbing for the desktop shell.

components.name: react-dom
components.usage: React renderer for the WebView DOM target (apps/desktop).

components.name: @tanstack/react-table
components.usage: Headless table engine for the virtualized data grid and statistical result tables.

components.name: @tauri-apps/api
components.usage: Typed IPC bridge between the React frontend and the Rust application services.

components.name: @tauri-apps/cli
components.usage: Development dependency: Tauri CLI (tauri dev / tauri build / tauri signer generate).

components.name: vite
components.usage: Development dependency: frontend bundler and dev server.

components.name: @vitejs/plugin-react
components.usage: Development dependency: React fast refresh and JSX transforms for Vite.

components.name: typescript
components.usage: Development dependency: static type checking of the frontend (tsc --noEmit).

components.name: bun
components.usage: Build-time tooling only (not bundled): JavaScript runtime and package manager used for frontend dependency installation and the Vite build.
